It was rendered as a generic two-quantity comparison: first a chart, then a stock hourglass pair. Neither shows 1.8 as ~7 units of 0.27. The rival value was drawn in the REST neutral at near-zero contrast.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show a single 1.8s pit-stop window that fills with ~7 discrete reaction-time ticks or blinks (0.27s each) as the crew finishes. Use one header only and legible ink on every value. Make Data the thing that blinks or reacts once per tick, so the count lands without reading.
